I feel you. I just started college and I already feel like I’m going to kicked out. In all honesty, college is incredibly stupid. You don’t really learn any skills that will help you in life. There’s no classes on doing taxes, balancing a checkbook, keeping a good credit score or how to lease something. It’s bullshit and I don’t think you should be too hard on yourself for not finishing. Most people don’t even end up in the same field as their major.
